note: Encore (ELS) resort on San Carlos Blvd on the way to Fort Myers Beach, 2 miles from the beach (a trolley stops out front); books single nights to the public. Dogs: up to 2 per site, none over 20 lb, no aggressive breeds; call for pet-site availability. --Claude
summary: Confirmed on the resort page and its NewBook engine: $68 base (Standard Full) to $113 (STD TC, Jan 2027), weekend 2 / holiday 3 night minimums, single midweek nights. Added 50-amp full hookups, 209 sites with a 40-ft RV limit, showers/laundry, year-round season, online booking link. Note trimmed of the rate and minimum-stay facts. Not stated: pull-throughs, wifi, dump station.
flags: Long-stay check: the resort markets annual and seasonal sites, but single midweek nights are sold online to anyone (2-night weekend minimum), so it passes. Family-proximity exception applies; no price gate.
Dog limit: 'no dogs over 20 pounds' and 2 per site (booking-page site description).
